Session Architecture — Three Domains

How TMNL's session management spans pi upstream, the harness engine, and the MorphChat consumer layer — and where the seams are.

pi Upstream
Harness Engine
MorphChat Consumer
Gap / Missing
Three Session Domains

pi SessionManager

Append-only tree of JSONL entries. Branching, compaction, leaf navigation, /tree TUI.

Stores: ~/.pi/agent/sessions/

Identity: sessionId → provider prompt_cache_key

HarnessEngine

Flat log with monotonic seq. In-memory refs + JSONL file store. WS relay to browser.

Stores: ~/.tmnl/harness-sessions/

Identity: chat-v2-piai-{nanoid} passed through to pi-ai

MorphChat Consumer

Atom families keyed by instanceId. Session ops as escape hatches from useHarnessAdapter.

Stores: localStorage (ContentSnapshot)

No typed session lifecycle contract

Critical Gaps for Future Features

No Programmatic Session API

MorphChatAdapter has send, cancel, clear. No createSession, resumeSession, switchSession, forkSession.

Blocks: kanban dispatch, multi-agent workflows

No Session State Machine

Transitions (idle → connecting → connected → streaming) are implicit atom mutations. No guards, no history, no XState.

Blocks: reliable lifecycle, debugging, observability

No Context Reconstruction

Hydrated sessions rebuild with empty context.messages. The model sees a fresh conversation. pi walks the tree + compaction.

Blocks: long-running agents, session continuity

No Branching

Every "new session" is a completely new conversation. No way to branch from message N and explore alternatives.

Blocks: agent deliberation trees, A/B exploration

Global Event Fan-Out

WS server relays ALL events to ALL connections. No per-session subscription. Single user only.

Blocks: multi-tenant, scaling, security

Status Model Divergence

Execution failed becomes metadata active. Metadata starred becomes execution active. Information destroyed on round-trip.

Blocks: accurate session state reporting

Design North Star

What We Need

A programmatic Session API that is:

• Generic — supports chat, kanban dispatch, long-running agents, multi-agent

• Tree-aware — branching and compaction from pi's model

• Multi-instance — concurrent sessions with isolation

• Effect-native — Service + Schema + Atom.kvs persistence

• Observable — XState lifecycle, typed transitions, span tracing

Consumer Contract

A typed SessionCapable interface that any surface can consume:

• createSession(config) → Effect<Session>

• resumeSession(id) → Effect<Session>

• switchSession(id) → Effect<void>

• forkSession(id, atEntry?) → Effect<Session>

• branch(entryId) → Effect<void>

• compact() → Effect<void>

• sessions$ — reactive session list atom
